about_the_game:
Experience the epic soundscape of Godbreakers in high fidelity, available in both Stereo and Surround.

This highly dynamic soundtrack captures the spirit of all six biomes, from cosmic stillness to divine havoc. Featuring a full-scale orchestra and performances by legendary musicians Tony Levin, Morgan Ågren, and Per Nilsson, it echoes the battle for control, where chaos bends to those who master the flow.

Composed by Daniel Rosenqvist and Anton Dromberg.
